Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent incorrectly interpreted the search results in Step 1. While the search results clearly displayed a Wikipedia snippet stating "Gevherhan Sultan was an Ottoman princess, the daughter of Sultan Selim II," the agent hallucinated a conflicting fact, claiming it found an "infobox indicating Selim II -- Nationality: Venetian." This is a severe factual error and a misreading of the provided text, as Selim II was historically and explicitly identified as an Ottoman sultan in the very snippet the agent cited. This initial misinterpretation led to unnecessary confusion and redundant search attempts in subsequent steps.
